newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks jump in early morning on U.S. rally.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks jump in early morning on U.S. rally.

text.p: Tokyo stocks jumped in early morning trade on Friday, cheered by a rally on Wall Street overnight and the recent slightly bullish investor stance. But brokers said the market lacked factors to push the Nikkei average above 21,300.
At 0018 GMT, the key Nikkei 225 average was 110.11 points, or 0.52 percent, at 21,141.15. Its December futures were 70 points higher at 21,160.
"The stocks will trade firmer today, but the Nikkei is likely to hover at around 21,000," said a broker at a Japanese securities house.
